sample.label: the-visit-is-the-outside-vantage
sample.rationale: This is the most concrete instance of the No Mind Checks Itself pattern in the whole family: a technical entry cannot see its own over-claim from inside, and the Philosopher Visit exists specifically to bring an outside-the-loop reader who can. The entry's own precedent (the oscillator visit) is a worked example of exactly the principle No Mind Checks Itself names abstractly.
sample.evidence: 'A poorly-researched philosopher produces a caricature that flatters the entry; a well-researched one says something the entry's author did not expect.' — the named precedent even found the entry's claim over-stated and 'offered the entry a smaller, more durable claim.'

sample.label: concert-without-conductor
sample.rationale: Coupling / sync / swarm entries (Kuramoto, flocking, BBS blackboard) → [[Confucianism]] (ren: coherence is between) or [[Leibniz (Indra's Net / monadology)|Leibniz]] (concert without a conductor).

sample.label: outside-the-loop
sample.rationale: Different problems (self-honesty about taste vs. self-auditing for error) sharing one deep pattern: a subject cannot reach certain truths about itself through direct self-report or self-inspection, and needs an external process — indirection in one case, a differently-angled mind in the other — to reach what the loop can't see from inside.
sample.evidence: Oblique Portrait: 'You cannot access certain interior material by pointing at it... The front door is locked — not by deception, but by identity.' No Mind Checks Itself: 'A self-model can only see as far as its own loop runs.'

sample.label: council-as-outside-vantage
sample.rationale: No Mind Checks Itself names three altitudes where a self can't audit itself (systems thinking, cognition, engineering practice) and explicitly wants 'to keep collecting the altitudes it recurs at until the pattern is unmistakable.' The Dialectic is a fourth, unclaimed altitude: embodying genuinely different voices in the same room so each can catch what the others' single perspective would miss — structurally the same move as decoupling maker from checker, done philosophically rather than procedurally.
sample.evidence: 'Real correction needs a vantage outside that loop — a differently-textured mind, not more effort from inside the same one.' (No Mind Checks Itself) vs. Dialectic's own claim that a researched voice 'generates responses that weren't scripted in advance' and produces 'knowledge of how a position behaves under pressure' no single voice alone could produce.
